history.content: ok so i found an old hard drive while cleaning out the closet. very productive saturday. anyway theres like a whole folder of stuff from when i was 19 and i opened it and just. nothing. felt like reading someone elses diary lol
That “nothing” after opening it feels like the clearest part, and the “someone else’s diary” line makes it sound oddly far away.

yeah thats the thing. like i KNOW it was a big deal at the time, theres pages and pages about this one person i was basically in love with. and reading it now its like watching a movie about a stranger. i remember the facts but the feeling isnt there. not even sad about it which is kind of the weird part
The part that stands out is how the facts are still there, but the feeling isn’t, and even the sadness doesn’t seem to show up. If you want, we can stay with that blankness a bit longer.

i guess so. its weird bc theres two things going on at once. like part of me is relieved? that whole period was kind of a mess and im glad im not that kid anymore. but theres also this little. dunno. like grief that i cant feel anything about it. as if i lost the person who DID feel it. does that even make sense or am i overthinking a dusty hard drive lol
It makes sense, yes. I’m holding both, relief about not being that kid anymore, and a quieter grief about not being able to reach the one who felt it.

yeah. honestly the relief is the loud one. the grief is more like a thing i notice when i poke at it, otherwise its just kinda flat. i think i deleted that person on purpose tbh. like at some point i decided not to feel that hard about anyone again and i guess it worked. mission accomplished, me from 22
The relief is doing most of the talking, and the grief only flickers when you poke at it. That sounds like a deliberate quieting, like you set out to not feel that hard again.

i mean it kept me safe i think. but now its like the setting got stuck. its not just that one person, its kind of everything. i dont really get swept up by stuff anymore, good or bad. i used to think that made me chill and low maintenance. tonight it just feels a little empty. anyway. didnt expect a closet clean to turn into this
That stuck setting sounds bigger than the old folder, and tonight it’s showing up as a little empty rather than chill. We can leave it here, or stay with that emptiness a bit longer if you want.

yeah lets leave it there. brain feels full enough for one closet lol. but this helped, naming it instead of just shrugging it off. gonna go put the hard drive back in the box where it belongs. thanks for sitting with the void with me
Of course, and I’m glad it got a name instead of just a shrug. Put it back in the box and let the rest of the night be smaller.
